# Dre Dyson

> > Technical guides and insights for AI-powered development with Cursor IDE, Claude 4.6 Opus, and modern software engineering workflows.

Dre Dyson provides comprehensive step-by-step tutorials for developers working with Cursor IDE, Claude AI models, and enterprise software development. The site focuses on troubleshooting, cost optimization, and practical implementation guides across domains including e-commerce, FinTech, HealthTech, MarTech, and cybersecurity.

## Key Topics

- Cursor IDE
- Claude 4.6 Opus
- AI-powered development
- Cost optimization
- File recovery and Git workflows
- Jupyter Notebooks debugging
- Enterprise AI integration
- E-commerce development (Shopify, Magento)
- FinTech PCI DSS compliance
- HIPAA-compliant development
- MarTech automation
- Cybersecurity threat detection
- IDE troubleshooting
- Version control best practices
- CI/CD pipeline fixes
